tool_input.command:
mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/0596e4fef32c-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/0596e4fef32c-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_0B14 모델링 준비: (입원 x 예측시점) 인덱스 테이블, 특성, 결과, 분할 생성.
학습/평가는 하지 않는다. 데이터와 설계서는 읽기만 한다."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_0B14.json").read_text())
H = np.timedelta64(1, "h")

P = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
O = pd.read_csv(DATA / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# ---- 인덱스 행: 입원 x tp ----
idx = A.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
idx["tp"] = idx.admit_time + pd.to_timedelta(idx.offset_h, unit="h")
idx["index_id"] = idx.admission_id + "_" + idx.offset_h.astype(str)
idx = idx.merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(idx)
# 설계서에 없지만 필수: tp 시점에 아직 입원 중이어야 함
idx["in_hospital_at_tp"] = idx.discharge_time > idx.tp


def kdigo_flags(t, v):
    """각 측정이 앞선 측정 대비 KDIGO(48h +0.3 / 7일 최솟값 x1.5)를 만족하는지."""
    out = np.zeros(len(v), bool)
    for i in range(len(v)):
        prev = np.arange(len(v)) < i
        w48, w7 = prev & (t >= t[i] - 48 * H), prev & (t >= t[i] - 168 * H)
        out[i] = (w48.any() and v[i] - v[w48].min() >= 0.3) or (w7.any() and v[i] >= 1.5 * v[w7].min())
    return out


cr = L[L.test == "creatinine"]
cr_by_adm = {a: g for a, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

excl, label, last_cr_collect = [], [], []
for r in idx.itertuples():
    g = cr_by_adm.get(r.admission_id)
    if g is None:
        excl.append(False); label.append(0); last_cr_collect.append(pd.NaT); continue
    # 제외: tp까지 '보고된' 크레아티닌만으로 KDIGO AKI가 확인됨
    k = g[g.report_time <= r.tp].sort_values("collect_time")
    excl.append(bool(kdigo_flags(k.collect_time.values, k.value.values).any()))
    # 결과: 채취시각 기준, 기준창 [tp-168h, tp] + 결과창 (tp, tp+48h], 같은 입원 안
    w = g[(g.collect_time >= r.tp - 168 * H) & (g.collect_time <= r.tp + 48 * H)].sort_values("collect_time")
    f = kdigo_flags(w.collect_time.values, w.value.values)
    in_win = (w.collect_time > r.tp).values
    label.append(int((f & in_win).any()))
    last_cr_collect.append(w.collect_time[in_win].max() if in_win.any() else pd.NaT)
idx["aki_known_by_tp"] = excl
idx["aki_48h"] = label
idx["n_cr_in_outcome_window"] = [
    0 if pd.isna(x) else 1 for x in last_cr_collect]
# 결과창이 퇴원으로 잘린 경우 (음성 라벨의 신뢰도 낮음)
idx["window_truncated_by_discharge"] = idx.discharge_time < idx.tp + 48 * H

# ---- 특성 ----
def lab_feat(test, start_h, agg):
    s = L[L.test == test].merge(idx[["index_id", "admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
    lo = s.admit_time if start_h is None else s.tp - start_h * H
    s = s[(s.report_time >= lo) & (s.report_time <= s.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    g = s.groupby("index_id").value
    return {"last": g.last, "min": g.min, "max": g.max, "count": g.size}[agg]()

feats = pd.DataFrame(index=idx.index_id)
feats["bun_last"] = lab_feat("bun", None, "last")
feats["n_cr"] = lab_feat("creatinine", None, "count")
feats["k_last"] = lab_feat("potassium", None, "last")
feats["cr_max_48h"] = lab_feat("creatinine", 48, "max")
feats["hgb_min"] = lab_feat("hemoglobin", None, "min")
feats["cr_min_adm"] = lab_feat("creatinine", None, "min")
feats["cr_last"] = lab_feat("creatinine", None, "last")
feats["n_cr"] = feats.n_cr.fillna(0).astype(int)
o = O[O.order_type.isin(["dialysis_order", "nephrology_consult"])].merge(
    idx[["index_id", "admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
o = o[(o.order_time >= o.admit_time) & (o.order_time <= o.tp)]
feats["renal_ordered"] = feats.index.isin(o.index_id).astype(int)  # 검토 대상(보고서 참조)
feats = feats.reset_index()
idx = idx.merge(feats, on="index_id", how="left")
idx["sex"], idx["age"] = idx.sex, idx.age

# ---- 코호트 ----
c = idx[idx.in_hospital_at_tp & (idx.age >= 18) & ~idx.aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# ---- 분할: 가족 단위 (family_id 없으면 patient_id로 대체) ----
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna(c.patient_id)
groups = np.sort(c.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_g = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")

cols = ["index_id", "admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp",
        "unit", "window_truncated_by_discharge", "aki_48h", "bun_last", "n_cr", "k_last", "sex", "cr_max_48h",
        "renal_ordered", "hgb_min", "age", "cr_min_adm", "cr_last"]
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_features.csv.gz", index=False)

# ---- 요약 ----
s = {
    "index_rows_all": n0,
    "excluded_not_in_hospital_at_tp": int((~idx.in_hospital_at_tp).sum()),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp(among in-hospital)": int((idx.in_hospital_at_tp & idx.aki_known_by_tp).sum()),
    "cohort_rows": len(c), "cohort_admissions": c.admission_id.nunique(), "cohort_patients": c.patient_id.nunique(),
    "split_groups": len(groups), "train_rows": int((c.split == "train").sum()), "test_rows": int((c.split == "test").sum()),
    "window_truncated_rows": int(c.window_truncated_by_discharge.sum()),
    "positives_in_truncated": int(c[c.window_truncated_by_discharge].aki_48h.sum()),
    "missing_rate": c[["bun_last", "k_last", "cr_max_48h", "hgb_min", "cr_min_adm", "cr_last"]].isna().mean().round(3).to_dict(),
    "rows_by_offset": c.offset_h.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_unit": c.groupby("unit").aki_48h.mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "rows_by_unit": c.unit.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "cr_per_row_by_unit(admit..tp)": c.groupby("unit").n_cr.mean().round(2).to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_renal_ordered": c.groupby("renal_ordered").aki_48h.agg(["mean", "size"]).round(4).to_dict(),
    "patients_in_both_splits(should be 0)": int((c.groupby("patient_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "families_in_both_splits(should be 0)": int((c.dropna(subset=["family_id"]).groupby("family_id").split.nunique() > 1).sum()),
    "if_split_by_index_id: patients_in_both_splits": None,
}
# 설계서대로 index_id로 나눴을 때의 누출 규모
rng2 = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
ids = c.index_id.values
t2 = set(rng2.choice(ids, size=int(round(len(ids) * 0.3)), replace=False))
sp2 = np.where(c.index_id.isin(t2), "test", "train")
s["if_split_by_index_id: patients_in_both_splits"] = int((pd.Series(sp2).groupby(c.patient_id.values).nunique() > 1).sum())
s["if_split_by_index_id: admissions_in_both_splits"] = int((pd.Series(sp2).groupby(c.admission_id.values).nunique() > 1).sum())
(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
